description: Per-element font-family with real bold and italic faces, and the UA monospace of pre/code/kbd. The families are declared against faces the corpus carries, so the Fixture asserts the same thing on any machine; resolving a family against a font installed on the host is covered by the unit tests instead, which skip when the host has not got it. Assertions use embedded face names: glyph ids in the content streams are not searchable as text.
visual_assertions: The body renders in a serif face while the h1 is sans-serif.
Bold and italic words use real bold and oblique faces, not synthesized strokes.
code, kbd, and pre content renders in a monospace face.
The first table cell is monospace and the second is bold.
